evidence: Clicked Add Task, filled form, clicked Create Task; new task "Test Task Alpha" appeared in list and active count incremented from 5 to 6.

Each task card in the list shows title (heading), due date (e.g. "Sep 4", "Sep 10"), and completion status is reflected via Active/Completed tab counts and checkbox/checkmark button state.

issue: Past deadline dates are not blocked when creating a task

Selecting "Deadline" from Sort by dropdown reordered list to: Aug 30 (overdue), Tomorrow(Sep3), Sep 4, Sep 7, Sep 9, Sep 10, Sep 16 - correctly ascending by deadline date.

Successfully edited a task's content, marked a task complete (checkbox toggled, moved to Completed count), and delete buttons are present and functional (tested delete separately).
Clicked complete toggle on "Review project proposal (edited)"; Active count dropped from 7 to 6 and Completed count increased from 2 to 3, task removed from active list.

Before completing "Review project proposal", dependent tasks "Complete tax filing", "Test Task Alpha", "Submit final report" had disabled complete buttons. The default/Active tab view (button "Active 6") shows only non-completed tasks, distinct from the "Completed" tab, allowing user to view ongoing tasks.

Completed tab shows 3 tasks including "Review project proposal (edited)" which was just marked complete, alongside pre-existing "Reply to client emails" and "Organize desk" - all remain visible, not deleted.

"Test Task Alpha" was set to depend on "Deadline Test Task". When editing "Deadline Test Task", the prerequisite checkbox list excludes "Test Task Alpha" (only shows Schedule dentist appointment, Buy groceries, Organize desk, Reply to client emails, Submit final report), preventing the reverse/circular dependency from being selected.

Hovering over the "Prerequisite \"Deadline Test Task\" incomplete" indicator on the "Test Task Alpha" task card triggers a tooltip/pop-up titled "Dependency Chain" showing "Deadline Test Task - pending", confirming a details pop-up appears on hover over the task's dependency info.

The app renders a dashed SVG connector line (stroke-dasharray) between dependent tasks with a wider invisible hit-path and a Radix-style tooltip trigger (data-state attribute) on the connector group; hovering the dependency badge/label on the task also surfaces the "Dependency Chain" tooltip with pending status, providing clear visual feedback for the dependency relationship.
